FROM knowledge_revalidation_impact i JOIN knowledge_revalidation_event e ON e.owner_id=i.owner_id AND e.id=i.event_id AND e.root_item_id=i.root_item_id JOIN knowledge_version root ON root.owner_id=e.owner_id AND root.item_id=e.root_item_id AND root.id=e.root_previous_version_id JOIN knowledge_version current_root ON current_root.owner_id=e.owner_id AND current_root.item_id=e.root_item_id AND current_root.id=e.root_current_version_id JOIN knowledge_version source ON source.owner_id=i.owner_id AND source.item_id=i.source_item_id AND source.id=i.source_version_id JOIN knowledge_version target ON target.owner_id=i.owner_id AND target.item_id=i.target_item_id AND target.id=i.target_version_id

SELECT i.id,i.status,i.metadata_revision AS revision,i.current_version_id,v.version_number AS current_version_number, v.title AS published_title,v.body AS published_body,d.title AS draft_title,d.body AS draft_body, adopted.version_number AS adopted_version_number,adopted.body AS adopted_body FROM knowledge_item i LEFT JOIN knowledge_version v ON v.owner_id=i.owner_id AND v.item_id=i.id AND v.id=i.current_version_id AND v.version_number=i.version_number LEFT JOIN knowledge_draft d ON d.item_id=i.id LEFT JOIN knowledge_version adopted ON adopted.owner_id=i.owner_id AND adopted.item_id=i.id AND adopted.id=#{adoptedVersionId} WHERE i.owner_id=#{owner} AND i.id=#{itemId}
mapper.update: UPDATE knowledge_revalidation_impact i SET i.revision=1,i.choice=#{choice},i.reason=#{reason},i.resolution_target_version_id=#{targetVersionId}, i.resolution_target_revision=#{targetRevision},i.decided_at=#{now} WHERE i.owner_id=#{owner} AND i.target_item_id=#{itemId} AND i.id=#{impactId} AND i.revision=#{expected} AND i.revision=0 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM knowledge_item k WHERE k.owner_id=i.owner_id AND k.id=i.target_item_id AND k.metadata_revision=#{targetRevision} AND k.current_version_id=#{targetVersionId})
